premises.text: Finding and booking fishing charters online is hard and time-consuming for travelers
premises.evidence_span: Finding and booking fishing charters online is hard and time consuming

premises.text: Charter captains lack a proper way to market their businesses online
premises.evidence_span: you don't have a way to market your business properly

premises.text: A marketplace lets customers find, book, compare, and review fishing charters
premises.evidence_span: a website where customers can easily find, book, and compare, and review fishing charters

premises.text: Captains get free profiles to manage availability and acquire customers
premises.evidence_span: captains get a free profile. They can manage their business, their availability, and get customers more easily

premises.text: Post-trip reviews and fishing reports help anglers choose better
premises.evidence_span: we collect all these reviews into a community that's on Fishing Booker and that helps anglers make better choices

premises.text: Customer acquisition is mainly via search with positive unit economics on bookings
premises.evidence_span: We use mostly search to acquire customers. And it costs us about $40 to get one person to book a fishing trip through our website. We earn about $125

premises.text: Seven-day customer service and 100% verified interviewed captains differentiate supply quality
premises.evidence_span: we have seven-day customer service. All of our captains are 100% verified, and we interview each of them
